newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish court sets May 26 date for Maastricht case.
newsitem.headline: Danish court sets May 26 date for Maastricht case.

text.p: A Danish court on Monday set May 26 as the date for the start of a suit by 10 Danes challenging the legality of Denmark's European Union membership.
The citizens' group, the Constitution Committee, says that since joining the EU in 1973, Denmark has ceded national authority to European Union institutions in breach of its own constitution.

Legal experts say that defeat in the case could oblige Denmark to renegotiate its EU treaties from scratch or try to amend the constitution, a complex operation requiring a general election and a referendum.
Danes, traditionally cool toward European integration, rejected the Maastricht Treaty outright in a 1992 referendum.
Voters grudgingly approved the treaty the following year on condition that Denmark opt out of economic and monetary union and joint defence, policing and citizenship arrangements.
